correctness.rationale: Mask product F_w(t)=Π_n exp(−2πit/3^n)[w+(1−w)cos(2πt/3^n)] yields zero levels 3^n(Z±alpha), with simple local zeros for 0<w<1/2, double local zeros at w=1/2 and no real zeros above. Collision iff (3^h sigma−tau)alpha integer; reduced q coprime to 3 gives nested progressions of period L=min{h:3^h≡±1 mod q}. Pairwise disjoint levels otherwise. Progression-density subtraction gives (1−3^(−L))²3^(-(m−1)L) for multiplicity m, total 1−3^(−L), even-multiplicity boundary density 2/3^(m+1) and weighted density 1. Continuity follows q→infinity off rational resonances. Independently enumerated rational-level sets to R=9000 for alpha=2/5,2/7,3/8,1/3,1/2 and reproduced all five total densities. The zero orders are analytic orders, not duplicate list entries.
